domain-information: A Visitor buys an admission ticket to access the museum’s permanent and temporary exhibits.
A Visitor joins a guided tour to learn more about the significance of selected artifacts.
A Curator selects artifacts for a new exhibition to highlight a specific historical theme.
A Curator updates exhibit descriptions to ensure the information presented is accurate and engaging.
A Curator leads guided tours to educate visitors about the exhibition.
A Conservator evaluates an aging artifact to determine the level of restoration it requires.
A Conservator applies preservation treatments to protect fragile items from further deterioration.
An Education Coordinator arranges a workshop for school groups to support interactive learning.
An Education Coordinator prepares learning materials to help teachers integrate museum content into their classes.
A Museum Store Manager reviews sales trends to restock items that appeal to recent visitors.
A Museum Store Manager administrates merchandise items connected to the latest exhibits.
A Museum Coordinator creates a schedule containing exhibits and workshops.
